raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #36675 (reported by the issue author; root cause confirmed in the thread by @mukeshbhandarkar).

`_process_messages` computes `xgrammar_reasoning = thinking_mode and (self.reasoning_parser is None)`, but `_get_reasoning_from_request()` returns `False` whenever no reasoning parser is configured. The two conjuncts are mutually exclusive, so `xgrammar_reasoning` is always `False`. With no `--reasoning-parser`, a chat template that turns thinking on (e.g. the Qwen3 `enable_thinking` default), a tool-call parser, and `tool_choice="required"`, the builtin xgrammar structural tag omits the `<any_text></think>` prefix and forces the model straight into a tool call while it is mid-thought — the opposite of what the adjacent comment says is intended.

## Modifications

- `serving_chat.py`: extract the template-toggle evaluation (the tail of `_get_reasoning_from_request`) into `_template_enables_reasoning()`, and gate `xgrammar_reasoning` on `reasoning_parser is None and _template_enables_reasoning(request)`. `thinking_mode` / `require_reasoning` are unchanged, so scheduler-side `ReasonerGrammarBackend` behavior (which requires a parser) is untouched; parser-configured behavior is unchanged (the existing kimi_k2 test still asserts `thinking_mode=False`).
- `test_serving_chat.py`: `test_parserless_template_thinking_reaches_xgrammar_tag` asserts on the real structural tag (`format.type == "sequence"` when thinking is on, including the template default; `"tags_with_separator"` when `enable_thinking=False`) and that `require_reasoning` stays `False`. It fails before the fix (`'tags_with_separator' != 'sequence'`) and passes after.

> This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude Code): issue triage, root-cause analysis, patch, and test; reviewed and submitted by the author.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit tests only (CPU):

```
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py   # 140 passed, 71 subtests
PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py             # Ran 140 tests ... OK
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A — request preprocessing only, no runtime path change.

- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation).

detail.title: [Fix] Let parserless xgrammar tool-call tags admit the template's reasoning prefix

files.patch:
@@ -1230,7 +1230,11 @@ def _process_messages(
         # SGLang's ReasonerGrammarBackend owns the reasoning prefix
         # when --reasoning-parser is configured, so builtin xgrammar
         # tags must describe only the post-reasoning tool-call suffix.
-        xgrammar_reasoning = thinking_mode and (self.reasoning_parser is None)
+        # Without a parser nothing else owns that prefix, so the tags
+        # must admit it whenever the chat template turns thinking on.
+        xgrammar_reasoning = (
+            self.reasoning_parser is None and self._template_enables_reasoning(request)
+        )
         tool_call_constraint = None
 
         # Apply chat template and its stop strings
@@ -2771,6 +2775,15 @@ def _get_reasoning_from_request(self, request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> bool:
             )
             return False
 
+        return self._template_enables_reasoning(request)
+
+    def _template_enables_reasoning(self, request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> bool:
+        """Whether the chat template puts the model into a reasoning phase for
+        this request, judged from the template's toggle config alone."""
+        config = self.template_manager.reasoning_config
+        if config is None:
+            return False
+
         if config.special_case == "always":
             return True

@@ -1233,6 +1233,53 @@ def test_xgrammar_tag_omits_reasoning_when_parser_owns_it(self):
                 parser.get_structure_constraint.call_args.kwargs["thinking_mode"]
             )
 
+    def test_parserless_template_thinking_reaches_xgrammar_tag(self):
+        """Without --reasoning-parser nothing else owns the reasoning prefix,
+        so the structural tag must admit it whenever the template turns
+        thinking on. The scheduler-side reasoning bookkeeping still needs a
+        parser, so require_reasoning stays off."""
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.template_manager.reasoning_config = ReasoningToggleConfig(
+            toggle_param="enable_thinking", default_enabled=True
+        )
+        self.tm.server_args.tool_call_parser = "qwen3_coder"
+        self.chat.reasoning_parser = None
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = "qwen3_coder"
+        self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.return_value = [1, 2, 3]
+        tool = {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {
+                "name": "add",
+                "parameters": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {"a": {"type": "integer"}},
+                    "required": ["a"],
+                },
+            },
+        }
+        cases = (
+            (None, "sequence"),
+            ({"enable_thinking": True}, "sequence"),
+            ({"enable_thinking": False}, "tags_with_separator"),
+        )
+        for chat_template_kwargs, expected_format in cases:
+            with self.subTest(chat_template_kwargs=chat_template_kwargs):
+                req = ChatCompletionRequest(
+                    model="x",
+                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2?"}],
+                    tools=[tool],
+                    tool_choice="required",
+                    chat_template_kwargs=chat_template_kwargs,
+                )
+
+                result = self.chat._process_messages(req, is_multimodal=False)
+
+                kind, tag = result.tool_call_constraint
+                self.assertEqual(kind, "structural_tag")
+                self.assertEqual(tag.model_dump()["format"]["type"], expected_format)
+                self.assertFalse(result.require_reasoning)
+
     def test_kimi_k3_constraint_failure_keeps_native_stop_format(self):
         self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
         self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
